license_required.quote: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who: (a) Uses words or any letters or title in connection with his or her name which in any way represents the person as engaged in the practice of dentistry

issuing_authority.value: Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada
issuing_authority.quote: the Board shall: 1. Adopt rules and regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter. 2. Appoint such committees, review panels, examiners, officers, employees, agents, attorneys, investigators and other professional consultants

name.value: Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada
name.quote: the Board shall: 1. Adopt rules and regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter

type.quote: the Board shall: 1. Adopt rules and regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter. 2. Appoint such committees, review panels, examiners, officers, employees, agents, attorneys, investigators and other professional consultants and define their duties

age_minimum.quote: Any person is eligible to apply for a license to practice dentistry in the State of Nevada who: (a) Is over the age of 21 years

moral_character_required.quote:
Any person is eligible to apply for a license to practice dentistry in the State of Nevada who:
(a) Is over the age of 21 years;
(b) Is a graduate of an accredited dental school or college; and
(c) Is of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited dental school or college
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of an accredited dental school or college

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited" means approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association or its successor organization

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: must present to the Board a certificate granted by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations which contains a notation that the applicant has passed the National Board Dental Examination with an average score of at least 75

exams.name: Clinical examination
exams.jurisdiction: state or Western Regional Examining Board
exams.quote: must: (1) Successfully pass a clinical examination approved by the Board and the American Board of Dental Examiners; or (2) Present to the Board a certificate granted by the Western Regional Examining Board which contains a notation that the applicant has passed a clinical examination administered by the Western Regional Examining Board

exams.name: Written examination on chapter and regulations
exams.quote: The Board shall examine each applicant in writing on the contents and interpretation of this chapter and the regulations of the Board

interval_years.quote: All other licenses must be renewed biennially

required.quote: Each holder of a license to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance must, upon: (1) Payment of the required fee; (2) Submission of proof of completion of the required continuing education

period_years.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations concerning continuing education in dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy and expanded function dental assistance. The regulations must include: (a) Except as provided in NRS 631.3425, the number of hours of credit required annually

value: Medical consequences of terrorism involving weapons of mass destruction (4 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder (2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Substance use and opioid prescribing (2 hours per licensure period for those registered to dispense controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: as part of continuing education, each licensee must complete a course of instruction, within 2 years after initial licensure, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism... Each licensee must complete, as part of continuing education, at least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure

available.quote: A regulatory body that regulates a profession pursuant to chapters 630, 630A, 632 to 641D, inclusive, 644A or 653 of NRS in this State may enter into a reciprocal agreement with the corresponding regulatory authority of the District of Columbia or any other state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold active license in another state, have been in practice for at least 5 years, not have had license suspended or revoked, not have been refused a license, not be involved in pending disciplinary action, pay applicable fees, and submit statement regarding child support compliance
requirements.quote: A reciprocal agreement entered into pursuant to subsection 1 must not authorize a person to practice his or her profession concurrently in this State unless the person: (a) Has an active license to practice his or her profession in another state or territory of the United States. (b) Has been in practice for at least the 5 years immediately preceding the date on which the person submits an application

exists.quote: the Board shall: 1. Adopt rules and regulations necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter. 2. Appoint such committees, review panels, examiners, officers, employees, agents, attorneys, investigators and other professional consultants and define their duties and incur such expense as it may deem proper or necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter

national_association.quote: "Accredited" means approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association or its successor organization

regulatory_model.quote: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who: (a) Uses words or any letters or title in connection with his or her name which in any way represents the person as engaged in the practice of dentistry, or any branch thereof

credential_type.quote: "License" means a certificate issued by the Board to any applicant upon completion of requirements for admission to practice dental hygiene, dental therapy, dentistry or expanded function dental assistance, as provided by the license

title_protection.quote: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who: (a) Uses words or any letters or title in connection with his or her name which in any way represents the person as engaged in the practice of dentistry, or any branch thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to exercise the degree of care, diligence and skill ordinarily exercised by dentists in good standing in the community
Lack of ability safely and skillfully to practice dentistry arising from lack of knowledge, impaired capability, substance use, or other cause
Suspension or revocation of license, imposition of fine or other disciplinary action by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a license to practice dentistry, the imposition of a fine or other disciplinary action by any agency of another state authorized to regulate the practice of dentistry in that state

disciplinary_grounds.description: More than one act constituting substandard care in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: More than one act by the dentist, dental hygienist, dental therapist or expanded function dental assistant constituting substandard care in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance, as applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing controlled substance or dangerous drug not required to treat patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, if it is not required to treat the dentist's patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having alcohol or other substance use disorder to extent rendering person unsafe or unreliable as practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder to such an extent as to render the person unsafe or unreliable as a practitioner, or such gross immorality as tends to bring reproach upon the dental profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or relating to practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or which relates to the practice of dentistry in this State, or conviction of any criminal violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain training required by Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain any training required by the Board pursuant to NRS 631.344

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to actively involve patient in decisions concerning treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to actively involve a patient in decisions concerning his or her treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring patient to enter agreement restricting ability to submit complaint to Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Requiring a patient to enter into an agreement that restricts the ability of the patient to submit a complaint to the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering immunization without required special endorsement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering an immunization if the dentist, dental hygienist or dental therapist does not hold a special endorsement issued pursuant to NRS 631.285

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to review diagnostic radiographs before orthodontic treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to review diagnostic digital or conventional radiographs for orthodontia before: (a) Making an initial diagnosis of or taking any action to correct malpositions of teeth; or (b) The initial use of an orthodontic appliance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with teledentistry informed consent requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 631.34583

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in illegal practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the illegal practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined in statute
Violating any regulations adopted by Board or provisions of chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any regulations adopted by the Board or the provisions of this chapter

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, the maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body, which care is provided by a dentist within the scope of his or her education, training and experience in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, the maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body, which care is provided by a dentist within the scope of his or her education, training and experience in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law

methods_authorized.quote: Evaluates or diagnoses, professes to evaluate or diagnose or treats or professes to treat, surgically or nonsurgically

drug_authority.value: Dentists may administer or prescribe remedies, medicinal or otherwise, as needed in treatment of dental or oral diseases, subject to controlled substance regulations
drug_authority.quote: Administers or prescribes such remedies, medicinal or otherwise, as are needed in the treatment of dental or oral diseases

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No licensed dentist or person who holds a restricted license issued pursuant to NRS 631.275 may administer or supervise directly the administration of general anesthesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation or deep sedation to dental patients unless the dentist or person has been issued a permit authorizing him or her to do so by the Board

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The Board may issue a permit authorizing a licensed dentist or person who holds a restricted license issued pursuant to NRS 631.275 to administer or supervise directly the administration of general anesthesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation or deep sedation to dental patients under such standards, conditions and other requirements as the Board shall by regulation prescribe

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: A holder of a limited license issued pursuant to this section shall notify the Board in writing by certified mail not later than 30 days after: (a) The death of a patient being treated by a dentist under the supervision of the holder of a limited license; (b) Any incident which: (1) Results in the hospitalization of or a permanent physical or mental injury to a patient being treated by a dentist under the supervision of the holder of a limited license

specialist_license_available.quote: The Board may issue a specialist's license authorizing a dentist licensed in this State to announce, hold himself or herself out and practice as a specialist in a special area of dentistry for which there is a certifying board approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A dentist licensed in this State to whom a specialist's license is issued shall limit his or her practice to the specialty

value: authorization by dentist without physical presence
public health dental hygiene without authorization or supervision
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote:
A dental hygienist may perform only the services which are authorized by a dentist licensed in the State of Nevada, unless otherwise provided in a regulation adopted by the Board.
3. Except as otherwise provided in NRS 631.287 or specifically authorized by a regulation adopted by the Board, a dental hygienist shall not provide services to a person unless that person is a patient of the dentist who authorized the performance of those services.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: The Board shall, upon application by a dental hygienist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter and has such qualifications as the Board specifies by regulation, issue a special endorsement of the license allowing the dental hygienist to practice public health dental hygiene

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A dental hygienist who holds a special endorsement issued pursuant to subsection 1 may provide services without the authorization or supervision of a dentist only as specified by regulations adopted by the Board

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: "Dental therapist" means any person who practices the profession of dental therapy and is licensed pursuant to this chapter

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: The holder of a license or renewal certificate to practice dental therapy may practice only in the settings provided in subsection 3, under the authorization of a dentist meeting the requirements of subsection 4 and in accordance with a written practice agreement signed by the dental therapist and the authorizing dentist

value: clinic or practice setting serving underserved populations
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: The holder of a license or renewal certificate to practice dental therapy may practice only in the following settings: (a) A hospital, as defined in NRS 449.012. (b) A rural health clinic, as defined in 42 U.S.C. § 1395x(aa)(2). (c) A health facility or agency, other than a hospital, that is reimbursed as a federally qualified health center

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Nothing in this section: ... (g) Prohibits the following entities from owning or operating a dental office or clinic if the entity complies with the provisions of NRS 631.3452: (1) A nonprofit corporation organized pursuant to the provisions of chapter 82 of NRS to provide dental services to rural areas and medically underserved populations of migrant or homeless persons or persons in rural communities

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Nothing in this section: ... (c) Prohibits the performance of mechanical work, on inanimate objects only, by any person employed in or operating a dental laboratory upon the written work authorization of a licensed dentist.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: All artificial teeth, dentures or other removable dental appliances, at the time they are manufactured or sent to a laboratory for repair, must be identified with the name or social security number of the owner

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the use of telehealth by a licensee described in subsection 1 of NRS 631.3458 who is located at a distant site to facilitate the diagnosis, treatment, education, care management and self-management of or consultation with a patient who is located at an originating site

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dental hygienist may, pursuant to regulations adopted by the Board, administer local anesthesia or nitrous oxide in a health care facility, as defined in NRS 162A.740, if: (a) The dental hygienist is so authorized by the licensed dentist of the patient to whom the local anesthesia or nitrous oxide is administered

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist may, pursuant to regulations adopted by the Board, administer local anesthesia or nitrous oxide in a health care facility, as defined in NRS 162A.740, if: (a) The dental hygienist is so authorized by the licensed dentist of the patient to whom the local anesthesia or nitrous oxide is administered

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: The Board shall, upon application by a dental hygienist who has the qualifications prescribed by subsection 2, issue a special endorsement of the license allowing the dental hygienist to practice restorative dental hygiene pursuant to NRS 631.3129

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: An expanded function dental assistant or dental hygienist with a special endorsement to practice restorative dental hygiene may perform the following acts under the conditions prescribed by NRS 631.288 and 631.31288: ... 2. Placing, condensing, contouring, adjusting, curing and finishing restorations that are made of a direct restorative material, including, without limitation, amalgam, resin-based composite and glass ionomer.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section and in regulations adopted by the State Board of Health pursuant to NRS 652.135 with regard to the records of a medical laboratory and unless a longer period is provided by federal law, each custodian of health care records shall retain the health care records of patients as part of the regularly maintained records of the custodian for 5 years after their receipt or production

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: The Board shall, upon application by a dental hygienist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter and has such qualifications as the Board specifies by regulation, issue a special endorsement of the license allowing the dental hygienist to practice public health dental hygiene
